objective: Evaluate external providers for the ORD-A08 Node staging runtime without creating infrastructure, authorizing billing, configuring secrets or deploying.
rationale: Railway maps directly to the existing persistent Node entrypoint and ORD-A08 health contract.
Railway exposes deployment, log and rollback operations while keeping the initial staging workflow operationally small.
Fly.io remains the preferred future candidate when Sao Paulo placement becomes more important than staging simplicity.
Render free cold starts reduce deterministic canary reliability.
Vercel general Node server support is recent and Sao Paulo managed compute is Pro-only.
nextAction: Wait for explicit Railway staging selection, then build a non-secret provider adapter and run only dry-run and check-env.
